sloka: सा वानराणाम् ध्वजिनी परिवार्य अंगदम् बभौ ।वासवम् परिवार्य इव मरुताम् वाहिनी स्थिता ॥४-६४-१२॥
transliteration: sā vānarāṇām dhvajinī parivārya aṁgadam babhau ।vāsavam parivārya iva marutām vāhinī sthitā ॥4-64-12॥

translations.english: 'If one succumbs to despondency while he has to exhibit his valour, his brilliance gets diminished and he does not succeed in his manly pursuits'.
